description:

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:Quarterly package review- Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.- Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.- Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.- Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.- Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.Group analyses- Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.One-off items- Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.- Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.- Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.REQUIREMENTS:Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.Languages: Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:Technical Skills: Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel);  experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).Soft Skills: Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.Essential Qualities: Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence  with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview:  We are building a highly accurate, evaluation-grade dataset of transcribed, multi-channel audio recordings to assess multilingual, multi-speaker AI systems. This project involves evaluating high-quality and realistic conversations representing diverse dynamics, contexts, and demographics. The Workflow:  Contributors record unscripted group conversations. These recordings are run through an initial transcription and diarization pass, which contributors then human-validate and correct. As a QA Specialist, you are the final line of defense, responsible for reviewing the end-to-end quality of both the audio recordings and the human-verified annotations. Key Responsibilities  Audio Quality Assurance:  Evaluate multi-channel audio recordings to ensure they meet strict technical and fidelity requirements. Verify channel isolation (ensuring no audio bleed) and confirm that recordings were captured in appropriate, quiet environments free from disruptive background noise, clipping, or low gain.  Transcription & Diarization Verification:  Review human-validated transcriptions to guarantee exceptionally high accuracy and adherence to strict low error-rate (WER) targets. Confirm that transcripts correctly capture spontaneous, unnormalized speech, preserving natural conversational dynamics such as overlaps, interruptions, and false starts. Validate the precision of turn-level and word-level timestamps, as well as speaker identification, paying special attention to complex, overlapping dialogue , while comfortably reading and validating the underlying JSON-formatted data to ensure accurate metadata tagging and timestamp logic.  Metadata & Content Review:  Verify the accuracy of all applied metadata, including demographic markers, contextual domains, and specific conversational tags. Enforce strict safety and privacy standards by auditing sessions to ensure no Personally Identifying Information (PII), toxic, or sensitive content is present. Execution & Reporting: Assess the end-to-end quality of the annotation task, assigning clear pass/fail or agree/disagree statuses during your review. Provide detailed, actionable comments and feedback whenever disagreeing with an annotator's work.  Requirements & Qualifications  Exceptional ear for audio fidelity and the ability to detect subtle background noises, channel bleed, or clipping. Meticulous attention to detail for verifying word-level timestamps and strict, unnormalized verbatim transcription rules. Native proficiency in Portuguese Ability to accurately assess complex multi-speaker dynamics.  Ideal Backgrounds include:  Linguists/Phonetics Experts: Deep understanding of natural, unnormalized speech patterns. Expertise in accurately identifying and annotating complex conversational dynamics, including overlaps, false starts, and backchannels. Language Teachers: Exceptional, native-level mastery of the target language. Ability to strictly adhere to verbatim transcription guidelines, documenting every stutter, filler word, and disfluency without applying prescriptive grammar corrections. Professional Transcriptionists: Ear for audio fidelity , rigorous timestamping skills, and experience meeting strict accuracy targets. Rigorous approach to precise turn-level and word-level timestamping.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it. The Role:  We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity. This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth. Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake. We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment. What You'll Do:  Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk. Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy. Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities. Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making. Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks. Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation. Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.  What We're Looking For:  10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses. Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls. Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives. Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them. Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level. Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk. Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers. Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector. Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Travel Buddies  Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen. Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür. Was du machst  Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns: Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus. Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst. Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden. Was du mitbringen musst  Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen. Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch. Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich. Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.  Was zusätzlich hilft  Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse Englisch fließend Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas  Was wir bieten  Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt. Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen. Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen. Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.  Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

title: Analista (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto
description:
Empresa está contratando Analista (a) SAP BW Hana - Remoto em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About HCLTech  HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving. The SAP BW Lead will be responsible for leading end to end SAP BW initiatives, including architecture, design, development, migration, and operational support across SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA landscapes. The role will also own real time and near real time data replication using SAP SLT, ensure performant analytics leveraging Native HANA modeling, and act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams. This is a hands on leadership role requiring deep technical expertise as well as team and delivery ownership. Key Responsibilities:  Advanced English  • Lead design and implementation of SAP BW on HANA / BW/4HANA solutions including modeling, data acquisition, transformations, and reporting layers. • Define and govern BW architecture standards, object reuse strategy, naming conventions, transport strategy, and performance benchmarks. • Own delivery across implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support engagements. Data Acquisition & Integration (SLT Focus) • Design and manage real time and delta data replication from SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA to BW using SAP SLT. • Ensure optimal data flow design covering ODP, SLT, and standard extractors, with reconciliation and monitoring frameworks. • Work closely with Basis and source system teams to ensure stable and scalable replication setups. SAP BW Modeling & Transformations:  o InfoObjects, ADSOs (Field based & InfoObject based) o Composite Providers, Open ODS Views o Transformations, DTPs, Process Chains Design and optimize Native HANA objects, including:   o Calculation Views, Table Functions, SQL Script procedures o CDS Views (where applicable) • Leverage push down logic to HANA to improve query and load performance. • Collaborate with BW and HANA teams to decide optimal BW vs Native HANA modeling strategy. Reporting & Analytics:  Oversee reporting solutions using:   o BEx Queries / Analysis for Office / SAP BO / SAC (where applicable) • Ensure reporting performance, semantic consistency, and business KPI alignment across domains (FI, CO, SD, MM, Supply Chain). Migration & Modernization:  Lead BW on HANA / BW/4HANA conversion and migration programs, including: o Readiness checks and simplification item handling o Remediation of custom code and data models o Data volume management and performance validation • Support S/4HANA transformation programs from an analytics perspective. Production Support & Governance • Act as escalation point for production issues, SLA adherence, root cause analysis, and resolution. • Ensure strong governance around transports (ChaRM), releases, incident/change management, and documentation. Team & Stakeholder Leadership:  • Mentor and guide SAP BW developers and HANA modelers. • Work closely with business stakeholders, functional teams, architects, and program managers. • Contribute to effort estimation, planning, and delivery commitments.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento. title: Head of Compliance, Brazil
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Head of Compliance, Brazil em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Overview  We are seeking an experienced Head of Compliance & MLRO to oversee the company's compliance and regulatory responsibilities in Brazil. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil. Key Responsibilities  Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business. Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs. Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements. Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations. Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required. Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities. Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations. Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting. Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions. Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management. Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization. Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters.  Requirements  Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field. Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets. Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred. Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations. Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous. Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial. Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus. Fluency in English and Portuguese.  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Accounting Analyst
description:

As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments. You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment. Specifically, your role will involve:  Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.). Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa). Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations. Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures. Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency. Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.  The ideal profile    We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you: Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS). Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings. Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil. Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting. Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus. Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.   Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.  Next steps in the process ✅  First Interview:  A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements. Second Interview:  A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media. Third Interview:  A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team. Final Step:  A proposition for us to start working together!  What’s in it for you  Remote Work Environment:  Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule:  We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:  As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:  Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun  . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund:  €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.  MoveUp Media 🚀  We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords. With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!   Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! Domínio do processo de gerenciamento de requisitos. Ter conhecimento da notação BPMN. Capacidade de realizar análise de cenário interno para definição de melhores práticas. Saber elaborar provas de conceitos conforme cenário interno. Conhecimento de desenvolvimento nos paradigmas de desenvolvimento Estruturado e Orientado a Objetos. A posição é remota, porém, caso resida na cidade de São Paulo e estiver há 24km do escritório da Unisys (Ponte João Dias), será presencial 3 vezes na semana.

Desenvolver modelos de documentos, relatórios, fluxos de aprovação e ferramentas obrigatórias para os gerentes de projeto. Auditar projetos periodicamente para garantir conformidade com normas e critérios estabelecidos. Monitorar indicadores globais de saúde do portfólio (ROI, desvio de prazo, controle de orçamento). Reportar o status consolidado de todas as iniciativas para a alta liderança por meio de dashboards e relatórios executivos.  Gestão de Recursos e Riscos  Otimizar a alocação de profissionais, equipes e orçamentos entre projetos para evitar gargalos. Identificar e mitigar riscos interdependentes que afetam múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, traçando planos de contingência corporativos. Intervir na resolução de conflitos por recursos entre diferentes departamentos, inclusive organizando a prática de gestão de partes interessadas, envolvendo clientes externos.  Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Cultura  Treinar gerentes de projeto e lideranças táticas nas melhores práticas de mercado. Promover uma cultura de eficiência, entrega de valor e foco em resultados por toda a estrutura. Gerenciar, capacitar e motivar a equipe técnica e funcional, promovendo um ambiente saudável e de melhoria contínua.  Para que você seja considerado(a) para a posição, é necessário apresentar:  Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PMO-CP (PMO Certified Practitioner). Inglês avançado/fluente (projetos globais e atendimento a clientes internacionais). Forte experiência em Gestão de Projetos, PMO ou Liderança, incluindo coordenação de programas, gestão de portfólios múltiplos (PPM) e interface com C-level. Experiência em sistemas no modelo SaaS. Domínio de frameworks ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) e metodologias tradicionais (Waterfall). Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de portfólio (Clarity PPM, Asana Enterprise ou MS Project). Capacidade de Storytelling com Dados  — transformar planilhas complexas em apresentações com narrativa lógica e plano de ação proposto. Vivência em Change Management : análise de impacto cultural, mapeamento de stakeholders e planos de comunicação. Ensino superior completo.  Nossos olhos irão brilhar, se você:  Espanhol avançado/fluente (diferencial para atendimento a clientes Latam). Experiência com ferramentas de BI e criação de dashboards executivos (Power BI ou similares). Experiência em empresas de tecnologia de alto crescimento ou scale-ups.  O que oferecemos:  Modelo Remote First : trabalhe de onde quiser de forma remota, mas caso queira, poderá visitar nossa sede localizada no coração de Belo Horizonte; Equipamentos de trabalho : disponibilizamos o principal que você precisa para poder trabalhar com tranquilidade; Jornada de trabalho flexível : aqui priorizamos entregas de qualidade, e não tempo desprendido; Cartão de benefício flexível Caju : valores mensais para você usar da forma que quiser (Refeição, alimentação, home office, mobilidade e cultura); Plano de saúde e odontológico;  Day off de aniversário : tire um dia para curtir e relaxar em até 90 dias após seu aniversário; Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;  Gamificação em nossa plataforma de engajamento : compute netcoins que serão revertidos em prêmios a cada trimestre; Educalex : benefício de incentivo à educação para a realização de cursos, workshops, palestras, aquisição de livros e mais! We have completed more than 130 projects in 10 countries helping improve lives while enabling communities to leapfrog or displace fossil fuels. QUALIFICATIONS 2+ years experience in nonprofit, economic development and/or aid program management, renewable energy, or a related field. College Degree (Associates or Bachelors) or significant work experience.  Demonstrated experience implementing aid or economic development programs and developing community partnerships. High level of cultural sensitivity. Strong project management and organizational skills. Fluent in Portuguese and Conversational to Fluent in English. Excellent written and verbal communication. Familiarity with Google Suite (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides). Some solar technical knowledge preferred but not required. With support from local and HQ staff, build and maintain strong relationships with community-based organizations, local governments, local partners and local NGOs. Help identify, assess and ensure the sustainability of high-impact projects that maximize benefits for a community while making efficient use of organizational resources. Generate and implement ideas for systems, programs, and operational improvement. Generate and implement ideas for systems, programs, and operational improvement. Oversee local project implementation from start to finish. Fill gaps: support EBL staff on administrative and organizational tasks as needed. Coordinate logistics and serve as liaison between local communities and solar installers. Coordinate and oversee site inspections and quality control.  Training & Capacity Building With support from Empowered by Light HQ staff, help develop and organize workshops and community trainings for renewable energy system maintenance and operations. Reporting & Compliance With support from Empowered by Light HQ staff, track and report on deployments, user agreements, usage metrics, and community impacts. DELIVERABLES Significant expansion of existing network of local partner organizations.  Defined planned for securing and reporting impact metrics from all projects in the region installed by EBL to date. Development of impact strategy for the Amazon Basin across 3-4 countries. Research and development of potential income-generating initiatives for communities to improve sustainability.  Collection of media collateral across all projects/regions (e.g., photos, testimonials, etc.)  ATTRIBUTES Excited to support a small, nimble, and impactful organization.  Adaptable. You feel comfortable saying, “I don’t know” or “I need help with this.” Self-starter. You are able to work independently and remotely without needing handholding. On board with advancing renewable energy technology, decarbonizing our planet, and working towards a just, equitable energy transition. You share our values. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.  Necessário:  Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais  para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço?  Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

description:

About Turing:  Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator  for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence  with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview:  We are building a highly accurate, evaluation-grade dataset of transcribed, multi-channel audio recordings to assess multilingual, multi-speaker AI systems. This project involves evaluating high-quality and realistic conversations representing diverse dynamics, contexts, and demographics. The Workflow:  Contributors record unscripted group conversations. These recordings are run through an initial transcription and diarization pass, which contributors then human-validate and correct. As a QA Specialist, you are the final line of defense, responsible for reviewing the end-to-end quality of both the audio recordings and the human-verified annotations. Key Responsibilities  Audio Quality Assurance:  Evaluate multi-channel audio recordings to ensure they meet strict technical and fidelity requirements. Verify channel isolation (ensuring no audio bleed) and confirm that recordings were captured in appropriate, quiet environments free from disruptive background noise, clipping, or low gain.  Transcription & Diarization Verification:  Review human-validated transcriptions to guarantee exceptionally high accuracy and adherence to strict low error-rate (WER) targets. Confirm that transcripts correctly capture spontaneous, unnormalized speech, preserving natural conversational dynamics such as overlaps, interruptions, and false starts. Validate the precision of turn-level and word-level timestamps, as well as speaker identification, paying special attention to complex, overlapping dialogue , while comfortably reading and validating the underlying JSON-formatted data to ensure accurate metadata tagging and timestamp logic.  Metadata & Content Review:  Verify the accuracy of all applied metadata, including demographic markers, contextual domains, and specific conversational tags. Enforce strict safety and privacy standards by auditing sessions to ensure no Personally Identifying Information (PII), toxic, or sensitive content is present. Execution & Reporting: Assess the end-to-end quality of the annotation task, assigning clear pass/fail or agree/disagree statuses during your review. Provide detailed, actionable comments and feedback whenever disagreeing with an annotator's work.  Requirements & Qualifications  Exceptional ear for audio fidelity and the ability to detect subtle background noises, channel bleed, or clipping. Meticulous attention to detail for verifying word-level timestamps and strict, unnormalized verbatim transcription rules. Native proficiency in Japanese Ability to accurately assess complex multi-speaker dynamics.  Ideal Backgrounds include:  Linguists/Phonetics Experts: Deep understanding of natural, unnormalized speech patterns. Expertise in accurately identifying and annotating complex conversational dynamics, including overlaps, false starts, and backchannels. Language Teachers: Exceptional, native-level mastery of the target language. Ability to strictly adhere to verbatim transcription guidelines, documenting every stutter, filler word, and disfluency without applying prescriptive grammar corrections. Professional Transcriptionists: Ear for audio fidelity , rigorous timestamping skills, and experience meeting strict accuracy targets. Rigorous approach to precise turn-level and word-level timestamping.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.  Offer Details:  Engagement type :  Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract  : 4 weeks  Evaluation Process :  Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and will be reached out for onboarding.

title: Advogado(A) Societário - Escritório De Contabilidade
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Advogado(A) Societário - Escritório De Contabilidade em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Vaga | Advogado(a) Societário — Escritório de Contabilidade - Campinas/SP.Estamos contratando um(a) advogado(a) para assumir a frente societária de Escritório de Contabilidade com carteira consolidada.Não é uma vaga de apoio jurídico genérico. É uma posição de especialista, com domínio técnico e autonomia de gestão.O que você vai fazer:→ Análise e condução de aberturas de empresas e alterações contratuais → Minutagem e desenvolvimento técnico de contratos sociais e contratos empresariais → Gestão da esteira de processos societários do escritório, do protocolo à conclusão → Desenvolvimento e execução de planejamentos patrimoniais e societários → Atuação junto a cartórios: averbações, procurações, escrituras e instrumentos diversos → Gestão de time — a posição lidera, não apenas executaO que buscamos:→ OAB ativa e experiência consistente em direito societário → Vivência prática com juntas comerciais, cartórios e órgãos de registro → Capacidade de redigir com precisão técnica — o contrato que você minuta é o produto → Perfil de dono do processo: organiza, prioriza e responde pelo resultado → Experiência prévia com gestão de pessoas ou prontidão demonstrável para assumirPor que essa posição importa:O societário é o ponto onde contabilidade e direito se encontram — e onde o cliente decide se confia no escritório para as decisões estruturais do seu patrimônio e da sua empresa. Quem assume essa cadeira não processa documentos: constrói as estruturas sobre as quais empresas operam.
